text:
Type: oak-effect picture frame with mat
Use: displaying a photo or print on a wall, shelf or desk; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, Japandi
Materials: oak-effect wood-grain frame, white mount board, clear front
Colors: light warm oak, white mat, light grey insert
Shape: portrait rectangle with a flat medium-width frame and mitred corners, white passe-partout around the picture, compact, hangs or stands
Feel: warm, natural, calm, simple
Goes with: white walls, light wood furniture, green plants, linen; Scandinavian, Japandi or minimalist rooms

product.name: RIBBA
product.description: The mount enhances the picture and makes framing easy.
